messages:
jordan: Heads up — planning week for the OSS reference app + short webinar. Goal: launch refapp + 3-part tutorial series, one mini webinar (30min) to drive early dev adoption. Want alignment on messaging, benchmark narrative, lead routing. Who's in?

sasha: In. We should emphasize cost/latency wins vs hosted competitors and the "developer-first" DX angle. Short benchmark bullets: 2-3x lower p90 latency on sample prompt, 30% token cost reduction with caching config.

mike: +1. I can build the tutorial repo and record 12-min demo video. Need final list of demo scenarios. Prefer: quickstart, batching/caching, and private deploy example.

anita: I'll share a perf graph from last week that shows the latency numbers. Also, can provide sample config for Dedicated vs Hosted. Attaching snippet below:
```yaml
server:
  batching: true
  kv_cache: prefix_enabled
  quantization: int8
```

lina: Ops note: for inbound leads — mark 'refapp-demo' as campaign and route to dev-ex Per their rule, leads with >3 seats -> AE handoff, otherwise automated nurture. We'll add utm params.

jordan: Great. Tweet + blog cadence: blog + refapp repo + tutorial 1 on launch day, tutorial 2 and 3 over next two weeks, mini webinar 3 days after launch. Social copy draft:
```text
New: Redwood RefApp — ship LLM features with predictable latency & cost. Live demo + how-to tutorials. Try the repo: <link> #opensource #llm
```

sasha: Email subject draft: "Hands-on: Build & ship LLM features with Redwood RefApp"

mike: For webinar, prefer gated registration with auto-join link that also gives repo access. DevRel can run live Q&A. Also suggest a 15-min lightning benchmark section.

devrel-bot: calendar: Webinar scheduled for 2024-07-10 16:00 UTC — provisional. Creator: mike

jordan: Action items: sasha — final blog draft + benchmark narrative (owner). mike — repo + 12-min demo + webinar host. anita — perf graphs + config samples. lina — utm/tracking + inbound routing setup. I'll own launch coordination and social scheduling. Can everyone confirm timelines by EOD Fri?

sasha: Confirmed, drafting now. Will post PR to /content by Thu.

mike: Confirmed. Repo skeleton by Wed, demo recording by Fri.

anita: Confirmed. Perf assets by Thu.

lina: Confirmed. Will create tracking tags + routing rule by Fri.

jordan: Cool. Quick checklist to attach to the launch doc: 1) blog + repo live, 2) tutorials published, 3) demo video, 4) webinar page + regs, 5) benchmark graphs + methodology note, 6) UTM + lead routing, 7) social schedule + creatives. I'll add to the launch doc.

sasha: One more: let's create a small "how we measured" section w/ prompt set + sequence lengths so claims are reproducible.

mike: +1. I'll add the prompt set to the repo under /bench/prompts.md

jordan: Perfect. Thanks all. I'll follow up with PR links and the launch doc. :rocket:
